SARFARAZ ALI SARDAR

Fund Accounting | Fund Administration | Trade Operations | Investment Operations

Cuttack, Odisha | +91 7749096929 | sarfarazali@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY Fund Accounting and Investment Banking professional with 4+ years of experience across Fund Administration, Fund Accounting, Trade Life Cycle Management, Trade Processing, Trade Reconciliation, Settlement, NAV/Valuation, Cash & Position Reconciliation, and Private Equity/Hedge Fund operations. Experienced in fund operations, investment transaction processing, NAV review, reconciliations, capital activity, investor reporting, audit support, and exception resolution.

CORE COMPETENCIES Fund Accounting & Administration • Trade Life Cycle (TLC) • Trade Processing • Trade Reconciliation • Trade Settlement • Cash Reconciliation • Position Reconciliation • NAV & Valuation • Private Equity • Hedge Funds • Fund of Funds • Capital Calls & Distributions • Investor Reporting • US GAAP • Audit Support • Exception Management • Root Cause Analysis • Stakeholder Management • Process Improvement

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE Deloitte South Asia LLP – Audit & Assurance (Fund Accounting) | Team Lead – Project Management Operations | Feb 2026 – Present

• Oversee NAV reviews, valuation processes, and audit deliverables aligned with US GAAP and client timelines. • Manage fund operations including cash monitoring, reconciliations, investor reporting coordination, and closure of audit/reporting cycles. Coordinate with cross-functional stakeholders to resolve operational issues and ensure timely delivery of reporting activities.

Lead project management operations within fund accounting for Real Estate, Private Equity, and Hedge Fund clients.

• Drive process improvement and automation initiatives to improve review efficiency and reduce turnaround time. • Support trade lifecycle activities across investment products, including trade capture, validation, processing, reconciliation, and settlement.

Incedo Inc. – Fund Services (Partners Capital) | Associate – Operations & Transformation / Private Equity | Feb 2024 – Feb 2026





Reviewed monthly and quarterly NAVs and valuations for Private Equity, Hedge Fund, and Fund-of-Funds vehicles, supporting financial reporting and audit deliverables. Performed cash projections, bank reconciliations, and liquidity monitoring while tracking capital calls, distributions, subscriptions, and fund cash movements.

Managed fund operations covering cash management, wire setup, credit facility maintenance, expense tracking, and capital

activity processing. Reviewed NAV capital statements and subscription, redemption, exchange, and transfer contract notes.

• Managed end-to-end Trade Life Cycle (TLC) activities across fund transactions, covering trade capture, validation, processing,

•

reconciliation, and settlement. Performed trade validation and processing, investigated trade exceptions, and coordinated timely resolution. Conducted trade reconciliation between internal fund records, Investment Managers, brokers, and custodians, resolving trade, cash, and position breaks.

Monitored pending/failed settlements, investigated settlement discrepancies, and followed up with stakeholders for timely





•

closure. Performed cash and position reconciliations as part of the trade lifecycle, validating transaction movements against bank, broker, and custodian records. Supported month-end closing and trade lifecycle controls to ensure investment transactions were accurately reflected in NAV and financial reporting. Prepared/reviewed FATCA/CRS and US tax reporting support documentation, including W-8, W-9, K-1 and K-3 related documents.

•

Implemented AI-driven process improvements, reducing review time by 20% and processing errors by 80%.

Amazon Development Centre India Pvt. Ltd. | Associate | Oct 2022 – Feb 2023

• • • •

Analyzed high-risk financial transactions and performed transaction validation to identify discrepancies and operational risks. Performed account and transaction reconciliations, investigating mismatches and supporting accurate financial records. Conducted transaction-level reviews, identified exceptions, and supported timely resolution through structured investigation. Performed risk analysis to identify potential fraud indicators and unusual transaction patterns. Supported financial control activities through transaction validation, exception management, and adherence to established procedures. Investigated transaction discrepancies and coordinated with internal stakeholders for clarification and resolution.

• Maintained documentation of transaction reviews, exceptions, and resolution activities while meeting quality and turnaround requirements.

Tech Mahindra India Pvt. Ltd. | Customer Support Executive | Aug 2021 – Oct 2022

Handled customer queries and service requests through defined support processes, ensuring timely and accurate resolution. • • Maintained accurate records of customer interactions, issues, resolutions, and follow-ups. • Managed escalations in line with defined procedures and ensured appropriate communication until closure. • Maintained service quality and turnaround-time standards while handling multiple customer requests. • • Analyzed recurring customer issues and feedback to identify opportunities for service/process improvement. Collaborated with internal teams to resolve complex issues and ensure a consistent customer experience.

Investigated customer issues, performed basic troubleshooting, and coordinated with relevant teams for resolution.

EDUCATION • • Higher Secondary Examination (Class XII), CHSE Odisha | 2019 | 71%

Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com), Utkal University – Christ College | 2022 | 70.55%

CERTIFICATIONS • • Global Securities Operations | 2023 • Operational Risk | 2024 • •

Chartered Institute for Securities & Investment (UK) – Introduction to Securities & Investment (International) | 2023

Investment Operations Certificate | 2024 edX Verified Certificate – Free Cash Flow Analysis

TECHNOLOGY Microsoft Excel • Microsoft Office Suite • Yardi • Workiva • SharePoint
